info.name: Directory Service
info.description: A collection for the Directory Service microservice, managing companies, terminals, and tracking audit logs.

request.description: Creates a new company. Access restricted to SYSTEM_ADMIN. providerLogin (the full login with its owner prefix) and providerPassword are required since 24.09.2026 (Р-93): every request to the acquirer goes with them. The password is stored encrypted and never returned; providerLogin is returned to SYSTEM_ADMIN only. A login already used by another company - 409. Since Р-94 the login must be MultiMerchantSys/<login>, active in the provider login snapshot (provider_logins, refreshed by ecom) with at least one active merchant; otherwise 400.

query.description: P3-1: подстрока без учёта регистра по name и id; % и _ ищутся буквально; пустая строка = нет фильтра

request.description: Retrieves one page of companies (paginated since P2-1, 22.08.2026): the answer is a PagedResponse — {content, totalElements, totalPages, size, number}. page defaults to 0, size to 20, ceiling 200; out-of-range values are clamped, not rejected. Ordered by name, then id. Soft-deleted companies are excluded from both content and totalElements. SYSTEM_ADMIN and AUDITOR only.

Free multimerchant logins for the company form (Р-95), SYSTEM_ADMIN only: logins from the provider login snapshot that pass the company login check (active, with an active merchant) and that no company uses, deleted ones included. Each carries the titles of its active merchants.
Retrieves detailed information for a company. Accessible by SYSTEM_ADMIN or company members.

Updates company details. Access restricted to SYSTEM_ADMIN. Every field is optional; an empty providerPassword keeps the stored one. The audit record names a password change without the password. status is ACTIVE or INACTIVE only, exact match; anything else is 400 (25.09.2026): DELETED is set by DELETE alone.
Soft deletes a company. Access restricted to SYSTEM_ADMIN.

exec: // Номер терминала выдаёт база (Р-81): запоминаем его для запросов с {{terminalId}}.

request.description: Creates a terminal from the provider directory, SYSTEM_ADMIN only since 24.09.2026 (Р-93): name, login and terminal number (terminalRid) come from the directory, a terminal has no password. The merchant must be linked to the company multimerchant login (Р-96) - pick one from Provider Terminals for a Company.

query.description: P3-1: подстрока без учёта регистра по name, login, id (как тексту), companyId и названию компании; работает внутри ролевого скоупа

request.description: Retrieves one page of terminals (paginated since P2-1, 22.08.2026): the answer is a PagedResponse — {content, totalElements, totalPages, size, number}. page defaults to 0, size to 20, ceiling 200; out-of-range values are clamped, not rejected. Ordered by name, then id. SYSTEM_ADMIN and AUDITOR see every terminal, company users only their own company's.

Lightweight terminal feed for selectors and name lookups (decision R-45, 22.08.2026). Returns a bare array of {id, name, status} — no pagination, and no terminal credentials: login and password are absent from the DTO, not masked. BLOCKED terminals ARE included on purpose: the link form takes only ACTIVE ones from the answer, while the transaction screen needs every terminal to keep naming the terminal an old payment went through. Access rules are the same as GET /api/v1/terminals.

Provider terminals the company may add (Р-96), SYSTEM_ADMIN only: active directory rows with a terminal number whose merchant is linked to the company multimerchant login and that no company has added yet.
Retrieves detailed information for a specific terminal.

Updates the terminal name, company or status. The login changes only through the provider directory reconciliation; a terminal has no password (Р-93). A terminal moves only to a company whose multimerchant login has an active link with the terminal's provider merchant, as on creation (Р-96, Р-97); otherwise 400, and a terminal without a provider merchant cannot be moved at all.
